Asc. ab Asc. R.’, ‘obliqua’ struck and ‘Recta’ written above it — a rule for passing from right to oblique ascension by the sign of the declination. Rear flyleaf: a faint ‘N 36’ at the head and a small blind-stamped cartouche near the gutter, both unread. Rear pastedown: in ballpoint ‘Gave jan. 1957 fra civiling. Oskar Ekman’ [gift, January 1957, from the engineer Oskar Ekman], the stamp HANDELS- OG SØFARTSMUSEET PÅ KRONBORG HELSINGØR – DANMARK [the Trade and Maritime Museum at Kronborg, Helsingør, Denmark], and ‘30:57’ in blue.
